description: This file defines the HLookup class, implementing the HLOOKUP function used in spreadsheet calculations. It includes methods for performing horizontal lookups within a specified range, handling array inputs, validation, and search operations.

classes.name: HLookup
classes.description: A class providing the implementation of the HLOOKUP Excel function, enabling horizontal lookup across ranges and arrays.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs an HLOOKUP operation, searching for a value in the top row of a range and returning a value from a specified row, with support for array inputs and exact/approximate matching.

methods.name: hLookupSearch
methods.description: Searches for a lookup value within a specific column of the lookup array, returning the matching row number or null if not found.

methods.name: convertLiteralArray
methods.description: Converts a literal array format into a structured array suitable for lookup operations, handling non-array values by wrapping them in arrays.

search-terms: search in top row of range
